description: For a language with countably many symbols, a countable original-name set, arbitrary equality-free premises \(\Gamma\), and equality-free \(A\), \(\Gamma\models_{\mathrm K}A\) if and only if \(\Gamma\vdash_{\mathrm I}A\) in the native equality-disabled calculus. Consequence quantifies over actual diagrams in universes containing the canonical frame and its term domains.
